one_line: Physicists in Calcutta who jointly discovered the Raman Effect in the late 1920s.

appearance.age_look: Raman appears as a dignified, lean man in his late 30s to early 40s; Krishnan as a slightly younger, medium-build man in his late 20s to early 30s.
appearance.face: Raman has a long, oval face, medium-brown complexion, sharp nose, thin lips, slightly arched brows, and calm, intense eyes with a thoughtful half‑smile; Krishnan has a softer oval face, similar medium‑brown complexion, rounder nose, fuller lips, and observant eyes with a gentle, focused expression.
appearance.hair: Raman’s hair is fully covered by a crisp white South Indian-style turban wrapped neatly with a smooth front band; Krishnan has short, neatly combed black hair parted slightly to the left, with a conservative side-part and no facial hair or headwear.
appearance.costume: Raman wears a well-fitted dark charcoal-black woollen Western three-piece suit (single-breasted jacket, matching waistcoat, and straight trousers), a starched white dress shirt with a stiff collar, and a deep navy-blue silk necktie; polished black leather Oxford shoes complete the look. Krishnan wears a slightly lighter charcoal-grey woollen Western three-piece suit, white dress shirt, and a muted maroon-burgundy silk tie; his shoes are also polished black leather Oxfords. Both have understated realism-era tailoring: no flashy patterns, simple narrow lapels, and modest single-button cuffs, in keeping with Calcutta scientific professionals of the late 1920s.
appearance.signature: A shared, worn, brass-and-black laboratory spectroscope mounted on a small wooden base that Raman lightly steadies with one hand while Krishnan holds a slender glass sample tube near its inlet, symbolising their joint experimental work on light scattering.

ref_desc: Raman, in a dark charcoal-black suit, white shirt, navy-blue tie, and white turban, stands beside Krishnan, in a charcoal-grey suit, white shirt, maroon tie, both medium-brown, fully clothed, jointly handling a brass-and-black spectroscope with a glass sample tube against a subdued dark palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet featuring two Indian physicists side by side in a 1920s Calcutta laboratory: C.V. Raman is lean and dignified with a medium-brown complexion, long oval face, calm intense eyes, and a crisp white turban; he wears a well-fitted dark charcoal-black Western three-piece suit, white dress shirt, deep navy-blue silk tie, and polished black Oxford shoes. Beside him, K.S. Krishnan is slightly younger with a medium build, medium-brown complexion, softer oval face, observant eyes, short neatly combed black hair with a left side-part, and no headwear; he wears a charcoal-grey Western three-piece suit, white dress shirt, muted maroon-burgundy silk tie, and polished black Oxford shoes. They stand close, clearly collaborating, with Raman lightly resting one hand on a worn brass-and-black spectroscope mounted on a small wooden base while Krishnan holds a slender clear glass sample tube near its inlet, their clothing modest and era-accurate, the palette dominated by black, grey, white, navy blue, and maroon, presented from head to toe for consistent redrawing.
